description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing comments within an event-based system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, and removing comments, and utilizes SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

methods.name: CommentPublic _to_public(c: Comment)
methods.description: Converts a Comment SQLAlchemy model instance to a CommentPublic schema object.

methods.name: list[CommentPublic] list_comments(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a list of comments for a specific event.

methods.name: CommentPublic create_comment( event_id: int, payload: CommentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new comment on an event by the authenticated user.

methods.name: None remove_comment( event_id: int, comment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.admin, UserRole.moderator)), )
methods.description: Marks a comment as removed; requires admin or moderator role.

ctags.name: create_comment
ctags.signature: ( event_id: int, payload: CommentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: list_comments
ctags.pattern: /^def list_comments(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> list[CommentPublic]:$/

ctags.name: remove_comment
ctags.signature: ( event_id: int, comment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), _: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.admin, UserRole.moderator)), )
